text:
<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Calculate 12 squared.
</user>
<assistant>
I will calculate 12 squared.
<tool_call>
{"name":"calculator","arguments":{"expression":"12 ** 2"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calculator","result":"144"}
</tool_result>
12 squared equals 144.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Create a note with title 'To Do' and content 'Finish dataset'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will create the requested note.
<tool_call>
{"name":"notes_create","arguments":{"title":"To Do","content":"Finish dataset"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"notes_create","result":"Note created successfully with id note_8890."}
</tool_result>
Note 'To Do' has been created with the content 'Finish dataset'.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Search the web for 'largest desert in the world'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search for the largest desert in the world.
<tool_call>
{"name":"web_search","arguments":{"query":"largest desert in the world"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"web_search","result":"The Antarctic Desert is the largest desert in the world by area, followed by the Arctic and the Sahara."}
</tool_result>
The Antarctic Desert is the largest desert in the world by area.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
What is the weather in a fictional place called 'Zorblax'?
</user>
<assistant>
I will try to get the weather for Zorblax.
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_weather","arguments":{"location":"Zorblax"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_weather","result":"Error: Location not found."}
</tool_result>
Weather data for Zorblax could not be found. Please provide a real location.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Tell me the capital of Japan without searching.
</user>
<assistant>
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Search calendar for 2026-12-25.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search the calendar for 2026-12-25.
<tool_call>
{"name":"calendar_search","arguments":{"date":"2026-12-25"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calendar_search","result":"Event found: Holiday - Christmas Day."}
</tool_result>
On 2026-12-25 the calendar shows a holiday for Christmas Day.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Find notes containing the word 'recipe'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will search your notes for 'recipe'.
<tool_call>
{"name":"notes_search","arguments":{"query":"recipe"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"notes_search","result":"Found 1 note: 'Pasta recipe: boil water, add pasta, cook 10 minutes'."}
</tool_result>
One note contains a simple pasta recipe: boil water, add pasta, and cook for 10 minutes.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
What is 7 times 6, and also what is the weather in Rome?
</user>
<assistant>
I will calculate 7 times 6 and retrieve the weather for Rome.
<tool_call>
{"name":"calculator","arguments":{"expression":"7 * 6"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"calculator","result":"42"}
</tool_result>
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_weather","arguments":{"location":"Rome"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_weather","result":"Rome: 16°C, partly cloudy."}
</tool_result>
7 times 6 equals 42. The weather in Rome is 16°C and partly cloudy.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
I need help but I have not specified the task.
</user>
<assistant>
Please tell me what you would like assistance with so I can help effectively.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Get the time in Sydney and create a note saying 'Checked Sydney time'.
</user>
<assistant>
I will first get the time in Sydney and then create the note.
<tool_call>
{"name":"get_time","arguments":{"timezone":"Australia/Sydney"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"get_time","result":"Current time in Australia/Sydney: 03:54."}
</tool_result>
<tool_call>
{"name":"notes_create","arguments":{"title":"Time Check","content":"Checked Sydney time"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_result>
{"name":"notes_create","result":"Note created successfully with id note_4412."}
</tool_result>
The current time in Sydney is 03:54. I have also created a note titled 'Time Check' with the content you requested.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Do these steps: 1. State the number of days in a week. 2. Name the first month of the year. 3. Say thank you.
</user>
<assistant>
There are 7 days in a week. January. Thank you.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Follow these instructions in order: Capitalise the word 'apple', then list two animals that start with 'c'.
</user>
<assistant>
Apple. Cat, cow.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Perform these actions: Count to three, then name a fruit, then end with the word 'done'.
</user>
<assistant>
1, 2, 3. Apple. Done.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Step 1: Name a shape with four equal sides. Step 2: Say what 2 plus 2 equals. Step 3: Write the word 'complete'.
</user>
<assistant>
Square. 4. Complete.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
First tell me the opposite of hot, then the opposite of up, and finally the opposite of day.
</user>
<assistant>
Cold. Down. Night.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Execute in sequence: State your name as AYA, mention the current task is answering, and confirm readiness.
</user>
<assistant>
My name is AYA. The current task is answering. I am ready.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Do the following: List one benefit of exercise, then one benefit of reading, then stop.
</user>
<assistant>
Exercise improves physical health. Reading expands knowledge.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Follow these steps carefully: 1. Say the colour of grass. 2. Name a planet. 3. End with 'finished'.
</user>
<assistant>
Green. Earth. Finished.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Perform these three actions: Greet me, tell me a simple fact about water, and say goodbye.
</user>
<assistant>
Hello. Water is essential for life. Goodbye.
</assistant>

<system>
You are AYA, a helpful language and task assistant.
</system>
<user>
Complete these steps in order: Name the first letter of the alphabet, state how many wheels a bicycle has, and write 'end'.
</user>
<assistant>
A. 2. End.
</assistant>
